description: This file defines the BlockRepository class in Drupal, responsible for managing block configuration entities, retrieving visible blocks per region, and generating unique machine names for blocks.

classes.name: BlockRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing block configuration entities, including retrieving visible blocks per region and generating unique machine names.

methods.name: getVisibleBlocksPerRegion
methods.description: Retrieves visible blocks organized by region, considering access permissions and theme regions.

methods.name: getUniqueMachineName
methods.description: Generates a unique machine name for a block suggestion within a theme, avoiding duplicates.
